dict.string: Aftercall records your side of the call to make private meeting notes. The audio is deleted after transcription.
Aftercall records the call's audio to make private meeting notes. The audio is deleted after transcription.
Aftercall reads the meeting you're recording from your calendar to name the notes and suggest who gets the recap. It never changes your calendar.
